name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Native details rows that open to their own height.
use: A list of headed rows that open in place: questions and answers, the stages of a build, sections of settings. Rows that share a name attribute keep one open at a time. It has no surface of its own: put it in a card or a sheet for a boxed list.

instead.when: It is one long text that shows its first lines
One panel is in view at a time and the others are a click away in a row of labels

keyboard.action: Open or close the focused row, as the native summary does

platform.fallback: The panel opens and closes at once

classes.name: accordion-item
classes.description: A row, on a details element; a hairline parts it from the next

classes.name: accordion-trigger
classes.description: The row's title, on the summary, with a chevron at its end

classes.name: accordion-content
classes.description: The panel: running text under the title

states.name: open
states.description: The panel is at its full height and the chevron is turned over

example:
Does it need JavaScript?
No. Every component is a native element with one stylesheet; the browser keeps its behavior.
Is dark mode a second stylesheet?
No. Every color token resolves with light-dark(), following the page's color scheme.
